title: Geofrontier
description: Towny Server With Active Moderators And Wars With A Earth Math, Historical server
body:
![GEOFRONTIER](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3a2ea950d55994c623af1286f5ec8d454dce5a5c.png)

*Forge your nation. Conquer the seas. Write your legacy.*

Welcome to **Geofrontier**, a cross-platform Minecraft server where **civilizations rise, wars are fought

We are currently in **Season 2**

---

![WHAT IS GEOFRONTIER](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5aa162d715e30591bd4cf152aca68795aea41ec0.png)

**Geofrontier** is a **Java + Bedrock compatible geopolitical survival server** built around nations, exploration, warfare, and economy.

Players build **towns, factories, mining camps, and naval fleets**, competing for influence in a living world where **strategy, diplomacy, and combat** all matter.

Whether you want to become:

* A **powerful nation leader**
* A **creative builder mastering his craft**
* A **merchant controlling trade**
* Or a **warlord commanding armies**

There is a place for you on the frontier.

---

![CUSTOM WEAPONS](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/902b81d03b36a9bf14155d9823d2b0d657faba7d.png)

Combat in Geofrontier keeps a balance of vanilla PvP and Custom Weaponry

You’ll have access to **custom weapons designed for large scale battles**, including:

* **Muskets** for ranged warfare
* **Greatswords** for powerful melee combat
* **Siege Weapons** for powerful **HUGE SCALE WARS** to break open enemy defences and leaving a opening for your soldiers to charge

Every weapon changes how players approach combat, encouraging **formations, tactics, and strategy** during battles.

---

![WEEKLY RANKINGS](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c40fa99b96a28e83836b73dce754b95f6656a565.png)

Using **Towny**, players can establish and grow their own civilizations.

Your town is powered by a **Town Core Crystal**, which represents the heart of your settlement.

Each week, towns are evaluated through our **Town Rating System**, rewarding the most successful communities with **special perks and bonuses**.

Your town can grow through:

* Building & Architecture
* Economic & Population Growth
* PvP Performance

Only the strongest towns will dominate

---

![RAIDS & WARS](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/18196963aa294d2630f5e4e2aa1142e09d5b21a7.png)

Conflict is a core part of Geofrontier.

![RAIDS](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6e7a39879987b59fa4c3d81af42476ff15c7ca03.png)

Raids can happen **without admin approval or consent**.
If you’re not prepared, enemies may strike at any moment.
There must be a greater quantity of defenders than attackers.

![WARS](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/040a11408edf5e5ffbaaff88f148032daf3bf019.png)

Full-scale wars require:

* **Consent from both sides**
* **An admin present to supervise**

This ensures that major wars remain **fair, organized, and epic**.

Prepare your defenses… or prepare your armies.

---

![THE SEA](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6f6451a4c603622e3b7e479aae822fad3988d726.png)

The seas of Geofrontier are vast — and dangerous.

Players can build and sail **custom boats and ships**, allowing you to explore distant lands and transport goods across the world.

But beware:

* The **ocean constantly pushes you away from the shore**
* **Sea monsters spawn** if you remain underwater too long
* The deeper the ocean… the more dangerous it becomes

Only the bravest sailors will master the seas.

---

![INDUSTRY](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a3436258100329a6760f5df530937daddf71117e.png)

Great nations require great industry.

Players can establish:

* **Factories**
* **Mining camps**
* **Automatic Farms**

Industrial power fuels military power, and the most advanced towns will dominate both **economically and militarily**.

---

![EVENTS](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7988efa001c85787e05d4d0096100fdd83162745.png)

Geofrontier regularly hosts **server-wide events**, including:

### Warzone Battles

Large scale PvP fights where players compete for **powerful rewards**.

### Building Competitions

Show off your creativity and earn **temporary boosts for your town**.

Events keep the world active and give every player a chance to **rise to fame**.

---

![SEASONS](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/de8f52702f3168d58a6c1b556394b1d4fd75be31.png)

Geofrontier runs in **seasons**, meaning the world evolves over time.

Each season introduces:

* A new Historical Timeline

**Season 2 is underway.**
The map is alive with growing nations and rising powers.


![JOIN NOW](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9817044d85710f031f7145a9f3833e073bee23dc.png)
